workflow: Shopify order sync, SKU mapping, fulfillment
scenario: Core SKU, primary market, single-unit order
required_evidence: Shopify order export, SKU mapping record, pick/pack log, dispatch confirmation, tracking number
pass_condition: Order syncs without manual re-entry, mapped SKU matches the ordered variant, and a tracking number is returned against the order

scenario: Multi-variant or bundle order, multiple components in one order
required_evidence: Bundle component list, per-component SKU mapping, inventory deduction record, packing photo showing all components
pass_condition: Every bundle component is mapped, picked, and deducted from inventory, and the packed contents match the component list

scenario: Branded packaging applied to a standard order
required_evidence: Packaging spec sheet, insert/label proof, pre-dispatch photo set, QC checklist sign-off
pass_condition: Packed unit matches the approved packaging spec and QC checklist is completed with photo evidence retained

scenario: Priority-market order routed to the designated carrier lane
required_evidence: Routing rule record, carrier acceptance scan, tracking event feed, first-scan timestamp
pass_condition: Order routes to the intended lane, carrier acceptance is recorded, and tracking events post back to the order record

scenario: Customer address change requested before dispatch
required_evidence: Change request timestamp, pre-dispatch hold record, corrected address in system, updated label, re-release confirmation
pass_condition: Address change applied before dispatch, label reissued to the corrected address, and the change is logged with timestamps

scenario: Full or partial cancellation requested before dispatch
required_evidence: Cancellation request record, line-item status in Shopify, hold/pull confirmation, inventory restock entry
pass_condition: Cancelled lines are stopped before dispatch, remaining lines proceed correctly, and inventory is restored to match the cancelled quantity

scenario: Controlled QC hold triggered on a batch before release
required_evidence: QC hold trigger record, defect/issue description, quarantined quantity, disposition decision, release or return-to-hold sign-off
pass_condition: Affected units are held and traceable, disposition is documented with named approval, and only approved units are released for dispatch

workflow: Inventory, SKU mapping, reversible phased migration
scenario: Recorded inventory does not match counted stock during a migration phase
required_evidence: Cycle-count sheet, system stock snapshot, variance report, root-cause note, reconciliation entry, rollback checkpoint record
pass_condition: Variance is quantified and root-caused, system stock is reconciled to the count, and the migration phase can still be rolled back to the prior checkpoint
